card.name: "A" before known hypersensitivity in contraindications
card.fires_on: The word "a" right after "contraindicated in patients with" in a CONTRAINDICATIONS section, where "known hypersensitivity" or "history of" usually follows.

modes.label: Contraindication opener
modes.description: The article "a" after "contraindicated in patients with", just before "known hypersensitivity" or "history of".

card.writes: It pushes the model to write the word "known" next, as in "known hypersensitivity".
card.plain: It fires on the "a" in "contraindicated in patients with a..." and prepares the word "known".
